description: Docker Swarm secret driver for 1Password Service Accounts (no Connect server required)

env.name: OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN_FILE
env.description: Path to a file holding the token, read instead of OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN. Keeps the token out of `docker plugin inspect`; requires the "token" mount below to be set to a host path

env.name: OP_DEFAULT_VAULT
env.description: Vault used when a secret has neither a ref nor a vault label

env.name: OP_CACHE_TTL
env.description: Cache resolved values in memory for this long (e.g. 60s). 0 disables caching

env.name: OP_TIMEOUT
env.description: Timeout for a single request to 1Password

mounts.name: token
mounts.description: Optional: bind-mount a host file holding the service account token. Set the source with `docker plugin set <plugin> token.source=/host/path/to/token`, and point OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN_FILE at the destination below
